Dependencies

Build and run (cluster):
- GCC with OpenMP support and OpenMPI, both from module foss/2023b (see slurm/env.sh)
- Slurm

Analysis:
- Python 3 standard library (scripts/collect.py)
- matplotlib (scripts/plot.py)

Visualization (optional):
- ParaView: open <dumpfile>.vtk written by any version when a dump file is given

GPU experiment (planned):
- NVHPC compiler (nvc) for OpenACC and/or CUDA toolkit (nvcc); availability checked with slurm/check_gpu.sh
